source_clause: EDPR6.3) Choosing “none” as a memory seat option will not be available and will be greyed out until the number of Profiles exceeds the number of Memory Seats.
leaf_desc_037: EDPR6.3) Choosing “none” as a memory seat option will not be available and will be greyed out until the number of Profiles exceeds the number of Memory Seats.
reasoning: 驗證目標：9.5.3（EDPR6.3）——「none」在 profile 數超過記憶座椅數之前不可用。關鍵情境條件：以 2 vs 2（相等，仍不可用）與 3 vs 2（超過，可用）構成邊界前後（§5.6），故取邊界值分析；**來源標示（J-12）**：座椅數 2 與 profile 數 2→3 為**測試設置** ——條文只給關係（profile 數超過座椅數），未給具體數字；條文之「exceeds」為嚴格大於，相等時仍不可用即為本 TC 之界前基準線。為什麼這樣切：座椅連結之交換規則屬 9.5–9.5.2，本 leaf 只管該選項之可用性。

tcs.tc_title: None option greyed out until Profiles outnumber memory seats
tcs.test_item:
None option greyed out until Profiles outnumber memory seats

(Verifies that the none option stays unavailable until the Profile count exceeds the memory seat count)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is equipped with two memory seats
2. Two Driver Profiles exist on the vehicle
3. The vehicle is stationary
tcs.input_test_data: Profile count vs memory seat count: 2 vs 2 (equal) → 3 vs 2 (exceeds)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the memory seat option list and read the “none” option
2. Create a third Driver Profile
3. Open the memory seat option list and check that the “none” option is available
tcs.expected_result:
1. The “none” option is greyed out and not available while two Profiles exist
2. The third Driver Profile is created
3. The “none” option is available
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
